hero.heading: Our Story
hero.intro: From a single distribution line in Yangon to an integrated group operating across marine resources, industrial supply, and nationwide distribution.

overview.heading: An integrated operator
overview.paragraph1: Sein Wut Hmon Group is one of Myanmar's leading conglomerates, operating across marine resources, fertilizer manufacturing, and nationwide distribution. The businesses reinforce each other: the fishery fleet anchors the marine line, the Marubeni fertilizer joint venture supports Myanmar's farmers, and the distribution network moves every product to 14 branch offices across Lower and Upper Myanmar.
overview.paragraph2: Today the group counts 250+ employees, 145+ distribution vehicles, 80 motorcycles, and 20 fishing vessels.

hero.heading: A coastline of 2,832 kilometers. A fleet built to work it.
hero.intro: Since 2000, Sein Wut Hmon has operated one of Myanmar's most established commercial fishing fleets. Twenty vessels. Ten million dollars in assets. A proven export capability rooted in one of Southeast Asia's richest marine environments.
hero.imageAlt: Fresh wild-caught harvest from Sein Wut Hmon's commercial fishing operations

overview.heading: Built for the water that built it.
overview.paragraph1: Myanmar's marine geography is among the most productive in the region. A <fig>2,832 km coastline</fig>, <fig>0.5 million hectares</fig> of coastal swampland, and <fig>8.2 million hectares</fig> of inland water bodies together yield roughly <fig>70,000 tons</fig> of flood fisheries output each year.
overview.paragraph2: SWH's fishery division was built to operate at the scale this geography allows, pairing a modernized fleet with onboard handling, shoreside cold storage, and documented traceability from vessel to market.
overview.quote: A single operator from harvest to export, rare in Myanmar, and deliberately so.

operations.heading: An end-to-end marine chain.
operations.intro: From vessel to port to buyer. Four connected capabilities, one operator.

fleet.title: Fleet & Vessels
fleet.body: Twenty modernized commercial fishing vessels, operated year-round across Myanmar's territorial waters and exclusive economic zone.

capture.title: Wild Capture Operations
capture.body: A commercial trawling operation focused on high-value marine species. Catch profiles are managed to international export standards.

coldChain.title: Cold Chain & Processing
coldChain.body: Onboard handling and shoreside cold storage preserve product integrity from harvest to port, enabling both domestic distribution and export.

export.title: Export & Distribution
export.body: Integration with SWH's broader logistics network connects catch to regional and international buyers, with documented traceability from vessel to market.

hero.heading: Myanmar, moved.
hero.intro: Fourteen branches. One hundred forty-five vehicles. Two hundred fifty employees. Sein Wut Hmon operates one of Myanmar's most comprehensive distribution networks, carrying international brands to every region of the country.

overview.heading: The country, reached.
overview.paragraph1: Distribution in Myanmar is not a logistics problem. It is an infrastructure challenge, a relationship business, and a test of operational discipline across geography that spans coastline, delta, and highland.
overview.paragraph2: Sein Wut Hmon has spent decades building the branch network, fleet capacity, and partner trust that turn imported products into nationwide availability.
overview.quote: Reach is not a route. It is the sum of fourteen offices, a fleet that runs, and the people who keep the promises behind both.

operations.heading: A network built for the whole country.
operations.intro: Four connected capabilities that turn international product into nationwide availability.

network.title: Branch Network
network.body: Fourteen offices across Lower and Upper Myanmar, positioned to reach population centers from Yangon to Mandalay, with last-mile coverage into secondary cities and townships.

fleet.title: Fleet Capacity
fleet.body: A combined fleet of one hundred forty-five vehicles and eighty motorcycles, scaled for the realities of Myanmar's road network and sized to handle cold chain, dry goods, and industrial distribution in parallel.

categories.title: Category Breadth
categories.body: Consumer electronics, food and beverage imports, industrial lubricants, and specialty retail. Each category supported by dedicated trade teams with product expertise.

partnerships.title: Partner Relationships
partnerships.body: Long-term partnerships with international brands seeking reliable, compliant, nationwide distribution in Myanmar, backed by documented performance and regulatory coverage.

lubricants.heading: Industrial and automotive lubricants
lubricants.body: As the sole agent of NASA Total Lubricating Solution from AC Lubricants Sdn Bhd in Malaysia, Sein Wut Hmon distributes industrial and automotive lubricants nationwide for transportation, machinery, and manufacturing customers across Myanmar.

overview.heading: Why we invest
overview.body: Community investment runs alongside the business. Where Sein Wut Hmon operates, schools, families, and neighbours are part of the operating picture. The group contributes through school support and learning facilities, disaster relief during floods and other emergencies, and longer term community development tied to the places it does business in.
